watches.name: Arctic Freedom
watches.description: "Be bold. Be the best. And conquer time itself." That was the promise. Arctic Freedom was created as the hero prop for an April Fools' campaign released by Vitreum during the public discussions surrounding the idea of the United States purchasing Greenland. The fictional trailer embraced every luxury watch cliché imaginable, presenting Arctic Freedom as the ultimate symbol of prestige, power, and freedom. To make the joke believable, an actual watch had to be built. Unlike every other Vitreum watch, the handwritten numerals are not applied directly to the dial. Instead, they are drawn onto a transparent intermediate layer suspended within the dial, creating the playful appearance seen in the film. It achieved exactly the visual effect the story required, but it also meant the watch was never intended to become a production model. What remains today is a curious piece of Vitreum history. Part movie prop. Part experimental prototype. Part fully functional mechanical watch. There will only ever be one. Please read before purchasing Arctic Freedom is offered exactly as it exists: a one of a kind experimental prototype. While fully functional and assembled around a Swiss mechanical movement, the dial construction is intentionally unconventional and does not meet the aesthetic standards required for a production Vitreum watch. The transparent intermediate layer, together with its visible imperfections, is part of the watch's original construction and should not be regarded as a defect. Arctic Freedom should not be compared to a regular Vitreum watch. Instead, it should be appreciated as a unique artifact from Vitreum's creative history. A watch that was never meant to exist beyond a fictional campaign, yet somehow did. By purchasing Arctic Freedom, you acknowledge that this is an experimental prototype and not a production model.

watches.name: Firebird (1195€ split payment)
watches.description: Crafted with care for detail and an immense passion for traditional crafts, the FH01 Firebird embodies the essence of elegance and artistic innovation. Fiery Elegance Envisioned with a design ethos that harmoniously marries sophistication with a nod to mythological heritage, the Firebird timepiece embodies a timeless allure that defies passing fads. It stands as a poignant testament to Vitreum's unwavering dedication to preserving traditional craftsmanship while embracing the spirit of innovation. Burnished by Fire What sets the Firebird apart is our exclusive "fire burnishing" technique, a proprietary innovation developed at Vitreum. Our master enameller Naomi Nevill has perfected this technique to enhance the dial's vibrancy and reflectivity. The result? A dial that transcends ordinary craftsmanship, radiating with an unmatched luminosity and vivacity. Inspired by History Within this elegant simplicity resides a nuanced tribute to history—the Haukbök numerals. Drawing inspiration from the numerals featured in the 1310 manuscript "Haukbök" by Icelandic Lawman Haukr Erlendsson, these timeless characters serve as a bridge between bygone eras and the contemporary age. Each meticulously pad-printed numeral encapsulates centuries of heritage and artisanal excellence, evoking the enduring legacy of horological craftsmanship. Availability and Delivery While the Firebird isn't classified as a limited edition, its availability is limited due to the intricate craftsmanship required for each timepiece. We operate on a first-come, first-served basis for deliveries, meaning early orders will be fulfilled sooner. Due to the high demand and meticulous production process, delivery dates may vary. Currently, deliveries are expected 3 months after purchase

watches.name: FH01 Aubergine
watches.description: Playful and elegant, this timepiece is adorned with a deep reddish purple colour, inspired by everyone’s favourite vegetable, the aubergine. The FH01 Aubergine showcases our meticulous craftsmanship and the beauty of traditional grand feu enamel. A Crowd Favourite Since we began our journey crafting enamel dials, we’ve explored a wide array of colours to discover those that truly captivate and resonate with the watch community. Out of all of them, the Aubergine hue has stood out as a clear favourite, and since revealing all of the colours earlier this year, this has been by far the most requested variant. A Harmony of Colours The golden-toned, heat-treated hands of the FH01 Aubergine are perfectly complemented by the sand-coloured numerals. We find that the contrast between the deep purple dial and the subtle, warm accents makes for a both striking and legible watch. Inspired by History At the core of its playful elegance, the FH01 Aubergine pays homage to tradition with the distinctive Haukbök numerals. Originating from the 1310 manuscript "Haukbök" by Icelandic Lawman Haukr Erlendsson, these ancient symbols bridge the gap between the past and present. They serve as timeless reminders of centuries-old craftsmanship, embodying the enduring legacy of horological artistry while adding a touch of historical charm to the watch's vibrant, modern design. Availability and Delivery While not designated as a limited edition, the FH01 Aubergine's meticulous craftsmanship limits its availability. Orders are processed in the sequence they are received, prioritising those placed earliest. Given the detailed production process and high demand, delivery timelines may vary. Deliveries are expected 5 months after purchase

watches.name: FH01 Emerald Green
watches.description: Crafted with precision and adorned in a deep emerald green, reminiscent of leafy woodlands, this timepiece is a testament to nature and the artistry of traditional grand feu enamelling. Into the Forests Deep From lush green canopies to moss covered forest floors, the FH01 Emerald Green timepiece mirrors nature's tranquil beauty and the natural landscape. The deep, rich hues of emerald green enamel, like rocky pools, reflect and refract every facet of the captivating hand-engraved dial. Fractured Emerald The FH01 Emerald Green's captivating three-dimensional pattern is intricatly hand-engraved to capture the essence of a fractured emerald, shimmering with iridescent brilliance. This delicate texture reflects and refracts the light through the enamel, evoking the natural allure of precious gemstones. Inspired by History In the heart of this refined minimalism lies a subtle homage to the past—embodied by the Haukbök numerals. These ancient symbols found in the 1310 manuscript "Haukbök" by Icelandic Lawman Haukr Erlendsson are enduring figures which symbolize a connection between the ancient past and modern era. These numerals capture the essence of centuries-old tradition and craftsmanship, honouring the enduring heritage of horological artistry. Availability and Delivery Although it's not a limited edition, the intricate craftsmanship involved limits availability. Orders are fulfilled on a first-come, first-served basis, ensuring early orders receive priority. Due to the meticulous production process and high demand, delivery dates may vary. Currently, deliveries are expected 4 months after full payment has been made.

watches.name: FH01 Arctic Blue
watches.description: Crafted with meticulous precision and inspired by the timeless beauty of grand feu enameling, the FH01 Arctic Blue embodies the essence of traditional craftsmanship and artistic innovation. Sophisticated simplicity With a design that seamlessly blends simplicity and historical reverence, the Arctic Blue timepiece offers a timeless aesthetic that transcends fleeting trends. It is a testament to Vitreum's commitment to honoring tradition while embracing innovation Inspired by history Amidst this simplicity lies a subtle yet profound homage to history - the Haukbók numerals. Inspired by the numerals found in the 1310 book "Haukbók" by Icelandic Lawman Haukr Erlendsson, these timeless symbols represent a bridge between the past and the present. Each pad-printed numeral embodies centuries of tradition and craftsmanship, serving as a reminder of the enduring legacy of horological artistry. Crafted by artisans Each Arctic Blue dial is meticulously handcrafted using the intricate grand feu enameling technique, a process that involves applying layers of powdered glass onto a sterling silver surface. Through multiple high-temperature firings, reaching around 800 to 900 degrees Celsius, the enamel fuses with the metal substrate, resulting in a smooth and resilient surface that is both durable and lustrous. Into the deep blue This painstaking process not only ensures the vibrant intensity of the deep blue enamel dial but also allows for the creation of intricate textures and patterns reminiscent of frozen landscapes. From the rich color depth to the delicate hand-engraved details, each Arctic Blue timepiece is a testament to the exceptional skill and craftsmanship of our artisans Availability Each watch is made to order and crafted with care. Please expect a delivery time of approximately four months from the date of purchase. We’ll keep you updated every step of the way.

watches.name: FH01 Storm & Sea
watches.description: The whispers of the wind and touch of the sea. Drawn from lush landscapes and the playful dance of the sea along the coast, this watch is a love letter to the place where many of our dials are produced, Wales. The dial mirrors the undulating waves in shades of deep blue and tranquil turquoise. The hammered texture, reminiscent of raindrops on the window, bringing a familiar pitter-patter to your wrist wherever you go. A canvas of dreams This watch holds within its heart a grand feu enamel dial, a canvas of transparent enamel layered meticulously over hand-engraved sterling silver portraying the ethereal tendrils of mist over the tempestuous sea in early morning as the sun struggles to break through. Each piece is handcrafted with unique freehand engravings and adorned with transparent grand feu enamel. Five unique masterpieces Each of the only five pieces created will be as unique as your fingerprint. Just like moments that make life extraordinary, these watches hold their own stories. Inspired by Japanese art With a subtle nod to the Edo period’s enchanting Japanese art, its design celebrates the harmony of air and sea with graceful, undulating waves. The delicate hammered texture mirrors raindrops on a window. Reduced Price Price: 3995€ Please note that this is a deposit payment for 50% deposit payment with the remaining half settled prior to shipping the watch in October.

watches.name: Dark Skies - Second Batch
watches.description: A STORM IS BREWING The FH01 Dark Skies was never part of the plan, but sometimes the best results come from the unexpected. What began as a simple test with a darker enamel revealed something far more atmospheric. A deep grey tone that gave the engraved texture a moody presence, like the sky just before the storm breaks. Crafted in solid silver and layered with grand feu enamel, each dial feels charged with tension. A watch shaped by chance, carrying the weight of something brewing. A Shift in Mood Like the Tempest Grey before it, the Dark Skies dial begins as a solid sheet of silver, hand-shaped and engraved with a flowing, organic texture. But where the Tempest feels open and windswept, the darker enamel here pulls everything inward. It deepens the shadows, sharpens the light, and turns the soft pattern into something more brooding. Like waves under moonlight or a sky thick with storm. The pale numerals float above it all, calm and precise, offering clarity against the unrest. You could call it the Tempest Grey’s moodier cousin. Still composed. Still quiet. But with an intensity that lingers. Clarity in Chaos There’s a quiet tension in the design of the Dark Skies. The dial surface is formed by hand, creating a soft, undulating texture that feels organic and unpredictable. Covered in dark enamel, it takes on a brooding presence. Deep, layered, and full of quiet movement. That richness is contrasted by the minimalist printing. Bright, deliberate, and anchored by the distinctive Hauksbók numerals. A subtle nod to Scandinavian heritage and a defining detail across the entire FH01 line. A Happy Accident The Dark Skies began as a happy accident. There was no concept, no intention. Just a darker enamel paired with a familiar texture, and a quiet moment of surprise when it emerged from the kiln. Something about it felt different. Deeper. Like it had caught a fragment of something we didn’t know we were looking for. Not everything worth keeping is planned. And sometimes the best ideas arrive uninvited. Availability & Delivery Due to the high number of requests from people who missed the first sales window, we are preparing a new, smaller batch of FH01 Dark Skies. Each watch is made to order and crafted with care. Please expect a delivery time of approximately four months from the date of purchase. We’ll keep you updated every step of the way.

A testament to meticulous craftsmanship and the timeless beauty of traditional grand feu enamel. Offering a subtle nod to the raw power of the elements. Under Stormy Skies With its subdued yet commanding shades of light grey enamel, reminiscent of brooding storm clouds, and a textured dial that echoes the churning waves of the ocean, the FH01 Tempest Grey embodies the dynamic interplay of nature's power and grace, capturing the drama of nature's most intense moments. On the Tempestuous Seas The FH01 Tempest Grey's boldly textured dial is expertly crafted, shaped by hand to mimic the tumultuous movement of a storm-tossed sea. As light plays across the enamel, the dramatic texture springs to life, immersing the wearer in the rugged beauty of the tempestuous ocean. Inspired by History At the core of its understated elegance, the FH01 Tempest Grey pays homage to tradition with the distinctive Haukbök numerals. Originating from the 1310 manuscript "Haukbök" by Icelandic Lawman Haukr Erlendsson, these ancient symbols bridge the gap between the past and present. They serve as timeless reminders of centuries-old craftsmanship, embodying the enduring legacy of horological artistry while adding a touch of historical charm to the watch's modern design. watches.name: FH01 Honeycomb v2
watches.description: A MESMERISING WORK OF ART We are thrilled to reintroduce the FH01 Honeycomb, a captivating timepiece that seamlessly fuses artistry, precision and elegance. This exceptional watch is the epitome of craftsmanship, expertly created by highly skilled artisans using the traditional champlevé enamel technique. Version 2 will have a warmer pallet, to better capture the delectable richness of honey. At the heart of the FH01 Honeycomb lies its breathtaking geometric design, meticulously crafted by artisans who hand engrave within delicate hexagonal cells, then fill them with many fine layers of vitreous enamel. The piece is then finished to the highest standard, resulting in our vibrant and intricate honeycomb pattern. You will be entranced by the captivating interplay of colours and shapes, a testament to the mastery and dedication of the artisans who brought this timepiece to life. One of few In our commitment to exclusivity, we have chosen to sell all 50 pieces of the FH01 Honeycomb v2 exclusively on our website. This means that each watch will be available for purchase at the same time, ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all our valued customers.

watches.name: Lunar Exploder
watches.description: Introducing the Lunar Exploder — a bold concept watch that embodies innovation, artistry, and a touch of whimsy. This very limited edition was created in collaboration with the Micro Indy Collective (MIC) and is exclusively available to its community members. The heart of the Lunar Exploder is its dial, which is Vitreum's most three-dimensional creation to date. Crafted from beautiful grey enamel, the dial boasts a deep, intricate texture that shifts appearance depending on the light and angle. The moon-like surface is a visual masterpiece, offering a dynamic play of shadows and highlights that captivates from every viewpoint. The story behind its name is as compelling as the watch itself. During its creation, the prototype unexpectedly exploded, an incident caused by the excessive amount of enamel used on the dial. This frustrating, but somewhat amusing, incident inspired the name “Lunar Exploder” — a playful nod to both the dial’s celestial aesthetic and the unforgettable event that brought it to life. A standout feature of the Lunar Exploder is the striking yellow indices that offer a bold contrast against the textured grey dial. The cohesive design extends to the strap, a refined grey Epsom leather adorned with yellow stitching that matches the numerals. This thoughtful attention to detail ties the entire piece together, creating a watch that’s as sophisticated as it is audacious. The Lunar Exploder is a unique concept watch with thoughtful design elements and a distinctive backstory. Its creative features and craftsmanship make it a special addition for those who appreciate originality and detail. The pictures were taken by MIC community members during the unveiling of the watch at Perpétuel in Dubai.

watches.name: Icebird (Blue Edition)
watches.description: Some ideas begin with a blank sheet of paper. Others grow naturally from the ones that came before. Following the success of the Firebird, we found ourselves wondering where else the same artistic language could lead. At the same time, we had begun experimenting with a series of opalescent enamels that behaved unlike anything we had worked with before. The two ideas came together almost by themselves. The result was the Icebird watches. Two siblings. One in white. One in blue. At first glance, the dial appears to be a crisp, icy blue. But as the light moves across the enamel, a soft golden glow begins to emerge from within. Rather than sitting on the surface, the warmth seems to radiate from deep inside the enamel itself, giving the dial an almost milky, luminous quality that is remarkably difficult to capture in photographs. It is constantly changing. One moment it appears cool and blue. The next, it reveals a warm inner glow that seems to float beneath the enamel itself. We always intended to bring the Icebird into production. Like many exciting ideas, however, other projects gradually took priority, and the concept was quietly set aside. One of the siblings has already found a home on the wrist of a collector somewhere in the world. The other remained with us. Until now. For the first time, the blue Icebird has been made available through The Playground. Whether it remains the only blue Icebird ever created, only time will tell. For now, this is your opportunity to own a piece that began as an experiment and became something far more special than we ever expected.

watches.name: Sands of Time
watches.description: Some of the most interesting ideas begin with a simple question. For us, that question was, "What happens if we move beyond the ocean?" Over the years, we've created numerous enamel dials inspired by waves and water. This time, however, we wanted to explore a much bolder texture. Instead of delicate ripples, we experimented with sweeping ridges that stretched across the entire dial, creating a landscape rather than a pattern. The result surprised us. While the texture had been born from experimentation, it no longer reminded us of the sea. Instead, it evoked the flowing dunes of a desert, where wind slowly reshapes the landscape one grain of sand at a time. It felt like the complete opposite of water. A place defined by its absence. That was when the watch found its name. Sands of Time. The warm golden enamel, combined with the sculpted relief beneath it, captures a fleeting moment in a landscape that is constantly changing. Just as the wind reshapes the dunes, time reshapes the world around us, so slowly that we rarely notice it happening. Ironically, this became one of our favourite textures and one of our most difficult to produce. The enamelling process proved remarkably unpredictable, and despite numerous attempts, this is the only example that achieved the result we had envisioned. For that reason, Sands of Time is likely to remain exactly what it is today. A singular experiment, born from curiosity, and a reminder that some of the most rewarding discoveries can never be repeated.

watches.name: Elsa
watches.description: Before Arctic Blue, there was a different watch with a much paler complexion. And we called her Elsa. Elsa began as an exploration of a new texture. A fractured, almost flaky surface that reminded us of ice. It was the first grand feu enamel dial we ever created using the texture that would later become one of the defining characteristics of the Arctic Blue. But the colour was very different. At the centre, the enamel is almost completely transparent, creating an exceptionally bright, icy appearance. Towards the edge, it gradually transitions into a delicate light blue, creating an unusual two colour fumé effect across the dial. The result looked almost like a sheet of fractured ice. Bright and crystalline at its centre, with icy blue gradually emerging towards the edges. We loved it. But at the time, another very light dial was already taking shape, a design that would eventually become Tempest Grey. Putting both into the collection would have taken things in a direction that felt a little too light. So we made a decision. The icy texture would stay, but the colour would change. We pushed the blue considerably further, and that decision eventually gave us Arctic Blue. Elsa remained. The prototype dial was kept and later assembled into the watch you see today. It represents an early branch in the development of Vitreum and a direction we ultimately chose not to pursue. And the name? Elsa seemed rather inevitable. A princess with the ability to turn everything around her to ice, with roots reaching back to Hans Christian Andersen's The Snow Queen. It seemed fitting for the dial that started Arctic Blue. Please read before purchasing Elsa is an experimental prototype. As with all handmade grand feu enamel dials, subtle variations are part of the character of the craft. Elsa was created during the development process that eventually led to Arctic Blue and was never intended as a production model. It should be appreciated for what it is: an original piece of Vitreum's development history and the prototype that helped pave the way for Arctic Blue. Specifications Case: Stainless steel Case diameter: 39.5 mm Lug to lug: 46.5 mm Thickness: 9.5 mm Lug width: 20 mm Movement: Sellita SW210, hand wound mechanical Power reserve: Approximately 42 hours Water resistance: Splash resistant. Not suitable for submersion. Dial: Grand feu enamel, made in Wales Crystal: Sapphire crystal Assembly: Denmark

watches.name: FH01 Phantom Black
watches.description: A Masterclass in Understated Elegance With its minimalist deep black fumé enamel dial, the Phantom Black is designed for those who appreciate quiet sophistication. What it lacks in extravagance, it makes up for in understated elegance. Look Closer At first glance, the Phantom Black appears to house a simple black dial. But this watch has a secret. Under the right light, the dial reveals a faint, dark blue glow at its centre – a subtle transformation achieved through the fumé enamelling process. This quiet detail adds an element of mystery and refinement, rewarding those who take the time to truly appreciate it. On the Tempestuous Seas The FH01 Phantom Black stands out for its unusual creation process and the remarkable happy accident that shaped this ethereal timepiece. You’d expect a layered grey enamel to simply darken into shades of grey, yet on a silver base, it reveals an inky blue tint at the centre, adding depth and character. This captivating detail is further enhanced by the subtle fumé effect darkening the edges of the dial to complete black Inspired by History At the core of its understated elegance, the FH01 Phantom Black pays homage to tradition with the distinctive Haukbók numerals. Inspired by the 1310 manuscript "Haukbók" by Icelandic Lawman Haukr Erlendsson, these ancient symbols bridge the past and present. They embody centuries-old craftsmanship, adding a touch of historical charm to the Phantom Black's modern, minimalist design while showcasing the enduring legacy of horological artistry. Availability and Delivery While not designated as a limited edition, the FH01 Phantom Black's meticulous craftsmanship inherently limits its availability. Orders are processed in the sequence they are received, with priority given to those placed earliest. Due to the intricate production process and high demand, delivery timelines may vary. Deliveries are expected 5 months after purchase Price We are deeply thankful for your support and enthusiasm as we prepare to launch the FH01 Phantom Black. As a token of our appreciation for your loyalty and contributions to the watch community, we are offering this timepiece at a special launch discount: • Retail Price: €2,495 Thank you for being a part of our journey!

watches.name: Bruce
watches.description: Sometimes a watch starts with an idea. Sometimes it starts with a question. I wonder what would happen if… Bruce started with exactly that. We had fallen in love with the texture originally developed for Aubergine, and naturally, curiosity took over. What would happen if we took that texture and pushed it in a completely different direction? The obvious place to start was with the dark grey enamel used for Phantom Black. But enamel rarely behaves quite as simply as you would like it to. A texture and colour combination that works beautifully in one dial cannot necessarily just be transferred to another. So we experimented. Different enamel constructions were tried, including intermediate layers of different enamels, until eventually something clicked. The result was Bruce. At first glance, the dial appears dark grey. But move it through the light and something else begins to happen. A subtle fumé effect draws the eye towards the centre, where the texture begins to come alive and reveal a remarkably subtle blue hue. At some angles it is almost invisible. At others, the entire character of the dial changes. It shares its origins with Aubergine and some of its colour DNA with Phantom Black, yet somehow looks like neither. That is often the most interesting part of experimentation. You can start with ingredients you already know and end up somewhere you never quite expected. At the time of writing, we cannot say if the watch will go into production, so for now Bruce is the only example of this particular experiment. Please read before purchasing Bruce is a unique, experimental prototype. As with all handmade grand feu enamel dials, subtle variations and imperfections are part of the character of the craft. As Bruce was created as an experimental prototype rather than a production model, some additional imperfections should be expected. It should be appreciated for what it is: a unique result of experimentation, curiosity and the wonderfully unpredictable nature of enamel. watches.name: FH01 Starry Night v3
watches.description: The FH01 Starry Night is a faithful recreation of the masterpiece by Van Gogh. Every brush stroke is painstakingly engraved by hand and the moon and stars have been created by placing tiny pieces of 24 karat gold between the layers of transparent enamel. This is truly a feat that requires both expertise and patience from a highly skilled artisan such as our master enameller, Naomi. To date, this is the most intricate dial we have made, and we have a feeling it will remain like that for a long time. The version 3 of the Starry Night features our updated handset, used in all current models.

watches.name: FH01 Emerald Green (balance payment)
watches.description: Crafted with precision and adorned in a deep emerald green, reminiscent of leafy woodlands, this timepiece is a testament to nature and the artistry of traditional grand feu enamelling. Into the Forests Deep From lush green canopies to moss covered forest floors, the FH01 Emerald Green timepiece mirrors nature's tranquil beauty and the natural landscape. The deep, rich hues of emerald green enamel, like rocky pools, reflect and refract every facet of the captivating hand-engraved dial. Fractured Emerald The FH01 Emerald Green's captivating three-dimensional pattern is intricatly hand-engraved to capture the essence of a fractured emerald, shimmering with iridescent brilliance. This delicate texture reflects and refracts the light through the enamel, evoking the natural allure of precious gemstones. Inspired by History In the heart of this refined minimalism lies a subtle homage to the past—embodied by the Haukbök numerals. These ancient symbols found in the 1310 manuscript "Haukbök" by Icelandic Lawman Haukr Erlendsson are enduring figures which symbolize a connection between the ancient past and modern era. These numerals capture the essence of centuries-old tradition and craftsmanship, honouring the enduring heritage of horological artistry. Availability and Delivery Although it's not a limited edition, the intricate craftsmanship involved limits availability. Orders are fulfilled on a first-come, first-served basis, ensuring early orders receive priority. Due to the meticulous production process and high demand, delivery dates may vary. Currently, deliveries are expected 3 months after purchase.
